shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline -3 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo "--- Select" && grep -nE "^\s+(value|defaultValue|onUpdate|options|width|placeholder|filterable|multiple|size)\??:" build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -20 && echo "--- Switch/Checkbox" && grep -nE "(checked|onUpdate|content|size)\??:" build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts build/esm/components/Controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "--- TextInput" && grep -nE "^\s+(value|onUpdate|type|label|note|errorMessage|validationState|size|placeholder)\??:" build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -20 && echo "--- Avatar" && grep -nE "^\s+(imgUrl|text|size|fallbackImgUrl|theme|view|icon)\??:" build/esm/components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts | head && echo "--- Flex" && grep -nE "^\s+(direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap|width)\??:" build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head && echo "--- Button" && grep -nE "^\s+(view|size|width|loading|disabled|type)\??:" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head

cat build/esm/components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts | grep -vE "^\s*$" | head -60 && echo "--- Switch" && cat build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && echo "--- Controls types" && sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/types.d.ts && echo "--- Select type" && sed -n 60,110p build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && echo "--- Flex Space" && grep -rn "export type Space" build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts && echo "--- Divider/Card/Text" && grep -nE "^\s+(variant|color|ellipsis|as)\??:" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5 && grep -nE "^\s+(view|type|theme|size)\??:" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head && echo "--- Toaster" && ls build/esm/components/Toaster

cat build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "^import|^\s*$" && grep -n "export type TextProps\|variant" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5 && grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|display-\|subheader-\|body-\|caption" build/esm/components/Text/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls build/esm/components/Text/
(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "exit:$?"

cp /tmp/render.test.tsx src/__render.test.tsx && npx vitest run src/__render.test.tsx --root . --server.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/uikit" 2>&1 | tail -15; rm -f src/__render.test.tsx dist -r; git status --short

cp /tmp/vitest.tmp.config.ts ./__vitest.tmp.config.ts && cp /tmp/render.test.tsx src/__render.test.tsx && npx vitest run --config ./__vitest.tmp.config.ts 2>&1 | tail -15; rm -f src/__render.test.tsx __vitest.tmp.config.ts; git status --short
